title: Density Increment Generalization to k-APs via Gowers Norms
description: Formalizes the generalization of Roth's density increment to k-term arithmetic progressions using Gowers uniformity norms. Gowers norms and k-AP counting operator defined constructively. For k=3, explicit density increment proved from RothTheorem infrastructure.

meta.author: Gowers (2001), Green-Tao-Ziegler (2012)
meta.assumptions: 2 axioms: generalized_von_neumann (k-AP count controlled by U^{k-1} norm via Gowers-Cauchy-Schwarz), density_increment_kAP (density increases on subprogression, AP-free preserved). gowersNorm and kAPCount constructive. density_increment_k3_explicit includes AP-free preservation via Roth infrastructure.
